_doc: REAL VENDOR BYTES, judged against the vendor's own published schema.
Every other recording this rig validates is busbar's OUTPUT. These two cells are Google's:
the response bodies are verbatim Vertex AI bytes (gemini-2.5-flash, us-central1, 2026-09-07),
copied from crates/busbar-llm-codec/src/tests/proto/golden/vendor/. Pointing the validator at
them asks a different and sharper question than the rest of the rig does -- not 'does busbar
match the spec' but 'does GOOGLE match the spec' -- and the answer decides whether a busbar
violation on the same field is a busbar bug or a spec that is behind its own wire.
Both cells are the GROUNDED turn on purpose: that is the shape that carries
toolUsePromptTokenCount and toolUsePromptTokensDetails, the fields the usage-identity

cells.why: real Vertex AI grounded tool turn: the buffered shape that reports toolUsePromptTokenCount (32) against an 18-token prompt
the same grounded turn streamed as SSE: carries groundingMetadata but never reports toolUsePromptTokenCount on any frame
